blockdesc-temporalloom-north: A Jonas device powered by temporal gears. Feed it flax twine and it weaves temporal fiber, which is made into temporal sewing kits.
blockhelp-temporalloom-gear: Power the loom (16 charges per gear)
loom-info-nopower: Out of power: needs a temporal gear
itemdesc-temporalfiber: A glowing blue-green twine woven from flax twine by the temporal loom, wound on a cupronickel stick. Craft it with a stick into a temporal sewing kit.
itemdesc-temporalsewingkit: Mends time into ruined cloth. Hold it and right-click a ruined tapestry; each repair uses 1 of the kit's 3 uses.
tapestry-repair-hint: Hold a temporal sewing kit and interact to repair.
ingameerror-loom-full-power: The temporal loom is fully charged
ingameerror-loom-full-flax: The temporal loom is full of flax twine
handbook-loom-text: The temporal loom is powered by temporal gears. rightmouse-click it holding a temporal gear to give it 16 charges (it holds up to 64), and holding flax twine to load it (up to 64). While it has both, it weaves one temporal fiber from one twine and one charge every 3 seconds. rightmouse-click it with an empty hand to take the fiber. Look at the loom to see its twine, charge and fiber. Breaking it drops the twine and fiber.
handbook-fiber-text: Woven from flax twine at the temporal loom. Craft it with a stick into a temporal sewing kit.
handbook-kit-text: Hold the kit and <hk>rightmouse</hk>-click a ruined (rotten) tapestry to restore it. Each repair uses 1 of the kit's 3 uses; nothing is used in creative mode.
itemdesc-temporaldecaykit: The reverse of the temporal sewing kit. Hold it and right-click a tapestry to make it rotten; each use takes 1 of the kit's 3 uses.
blockdesc-decayloom-north: The temporal loom's inverse: a Jonas device powered by rusty gears. Feed it flax twine and it unravels it into decayed fiber, which is made into temporal decay kits.
handbook-decayloom-text: Works exactly like the temporal loom, but runs on rusty gears (16 charges each, up to 64). rightmouse-click it with a rusty gear to power it, with flax twine to load it, and with an empty hand to take the decayed fiber it makes, one per twine and charge every 3 seconds.
itemdesc-decayedfiber: A dark, brittle twine unraveled from flax twine by the unraveling loom. Craft it with a stick into a temporal decay kit.
handbook-decayedfiber-text: Made from flax twine at the unraveling loom. Craft it with a stick into a temporal decay kit.
handbook-decaykit-text: Hold the kit and rightmouse-click a tapestry that is not rotten to make it rot. Each use takes 1 of the kit's 3 uses; nothing is used in creative mode. A temporal sewing kit repairs it again.
